remarks: Open peering policy, e-mail <dn42@iputils.de> or matrix @notupus:altillimity.com
MP-BGP with ENH over IPv6 link-local is preferred
BFD is a good idea, feel free to ask for it I will implent it gladly
RFC1997, RFC3765, RFC7999 and RFC8326 are implemented as described in the RFC.R
Routes with the BLACKHOLE community are redistributed to other peers if they implement the RFC7999 as well.
mp-import: afi any.unicast from AS-ANY accept ANY
afi any.unicast from AS-NOT-TRANSIT accept ANY
afi any.unicast from AS-NOT-PEER accept ANY
afi any.unicast from AS-NOT:AS-PEER-STRICT accept PEERAS
mp-export: afi any.unicast to AS-ANY announce ANY
afi any.unicast to AS-NOT-TRANSIT announce ANY
afi any.unicast to AS-NOT:AS-PEER announce AS-NOT
afi any.unicast to AS-NOT:AS-PEER-STRICT announce AS-NOT
